wireguard_foreign_hairpin_filter_diagnos.attempted_location: WG client on France to Iran public UDP ingress
wireguard_foreign_hairpin_filter_diagnos.result: France-side capture saw outgoing real WireGuard handshake packets; matched Iran-side capture saw zero real handshakes, while 8/8 synthetic 148-byte UDP control probes on same IP/port were observed.
wireguard_foreign_hairpin_filter_diagnos.inference: Possible distinctive handshake filtering on France-to-Iran route, not confirmed as the cause of all failed WG connections.

openvpn_udp.test_configuration: France-only UDP OpenVPN client to Iran public ingress via two Rakhsh datagram carriers to France UDP OpenVPN server; separate test PKI.
openvpn_udp.does_not_prove: zero loss under sustained customer load or physical-path outages

wireguard_iran_clients.setup: Two temporary kernel WireGuard clients on Iran host connect to Iran UDP ingress; temporary kernel WireGuard server stays on France.
wireguard_iran_clients.result: Authenticated WireGuard handshakes and decrypted data reached the French test server while GRE was intentionally stopped and restored.
wireguard_iran_clients.limitations: An exact sequence-by-sequence packet loss or latency metric during outage was not collected. Client report shell string interpolation bug caused exit=1 after traffic; cleanup trap ran, and issue subsequently fixed in script.

wireguard_success: real dual-client authenticated lab success with tunnel data, not a production canary
openvpn_udp_success: real one-client UDP lab data survived a short GRE outage (80/80)
